newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt October oilfields output rises by 10,000 bpd.
newsitem.headline: Egypt October oilfields output rises by 10,000 bpd.

text.p: Egypt's offshore October oilfields have increased output to 165,000 barrels per day (bpd) and are now the country's largest producer, Oil Minister Hamdi el-Banbi said in comments published on Monday.
Oil ministry officials said its output had increased by 10,000 bpd. Egypt produced about 836,000 bpd during May.

Banbi was quoted by the government newspaper al-Ahram as saying that production at the fields in the northern Gulf of Suez would rise to 200,000 bpd after a new offshore rig is built at the East Tanka field, which is part of the area.
Officials estimate the field will increase production by the end of 1997.
The October fields are operated by Gulf of Suez Petroleum (GUPCO), a joint venture between U.S. firm Amoco Corp and the state's Egyptian General Petroleum Corporation (EGPC).
